---
title: "What does the optimised design look like?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
# Same call as the flight entry, so the drawing is of the aircraft that flew.
result = optimised_flight()
layout, solved = result["layout"], result["solved"]

c_root = layout["c_root"]
c_tip = c_root * solved["taper"]
all_up = structural_mass(layout)["total"].mass + solved["ballast"]
# Nose to tail, off the drawn geometry rather than from the ratios that set it.
length = max(float(x.xyz_le[0]) + float(x.chord)
             for w in result["airplane"].wings for x in w.xsecs)

assert c_root > 2 * c_tip                     # strongly tapered, not rectangular
assert solved["ballast"] / all_up > 0.25      # a third of it is lead
assert length > 3 * layout["span"]            # and it is absurdly long: see below
```

::: {.hero-pair}
::: {.hero-ref}
[`{python} f"{length * 1e3:.0f}"` mm]{.hero-value}
[long, on a `{python} f"{layout['span'] * 1e3:.0f}"` mm span]{.hero-label}
:::
::: {}
[`{python} f"{all_up * 1e3:.1f}"` g]{.hero-value}
[all up, `{python} f"{solved['ballast'] * 1e3:.1f}"` g of it lead]{.hero-label}
:::
:::

**Answer.** A broad tapered plate on an absurd boom. The chord runs
`{python} f"{c_root * 1e3:.0f}"` to `{python} f"{c_tip * 1e3:.0f}"` mm across a
`{python} f"{layout['span'] * 1e3:.0f}"` mm span — but the tail arm is held in
CHORDS, so that fat chord throws the tail
`{python} f"{3.6 * c_root * 1e3:.0f}"` mm back and the aeroplane is
[`{python} f"{length / layout['span']:.1f}"`× its own span]{.key} long
(@fig-design). Nothing prices a metre of foam boom.

::: {.callout-warning}
## A ratio held is not a dimension held
Pinning the tail arm in chords was conservative in volume and wild in millimetres.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Assumed

1. **Tail held** at McEagle proportions.
2. **No length limit**; the model has none.
3. **Ballast at the nose**, position not free.
4. **Aspect ratio and taper** stop on my bounds.
:::

```{python}
#| label: fig-design
#| fig-cap: "The optimised airframe to scale. A short deep tapered wing on a long nose, with the tail held at baseline proportions. Dihedral and fin are inherited, not results — the model has no lateral dynamics to value them."
result["airplane"].draw_three_view(show=False)
plt.show()
```
